title: sensor_archetype
description: EchoForge sensor_archetype document. Declares a radar sensor archetype (band, waveform family, RF and sampling parameters) used to parameterize scenarios and episodes. Conforms to the EchoForge strict-open contract: deterministic ids, explicit provenance, license, and validation envelope.

id.description: Deterministic EchoForge id of the form ef:<kind>:<public_proxy_id>:<16hex>:1, computed from the identity field tuple.

kind.description: Document kind discriminator; must be the literal string "sensor_archetype".

schema_version.description: Schema contract version this document conforms to (currently pinned to 1.0.0).

public_proxy_id.description: Slug identifying the public proxy this sensor archetype is derived from (lowercase, dot/underscore/hyphen separated).

provenance.description: Provenance envelope: source kind, source references, generator, timestamp, and payload fingerprint.

license.description: License envelope (SPDX id and optional notice) governing use of this document.

validation.description: Validation envelope: tier, overall status, uncertainty score, and per-check results.

sensor_name.description: Human-readable name of the sensor archetype (e.g. "generic_xband_pulse_doppler"); non-empty string.

band_name.description: Radar band designation. Typical values: HF|VHF|UHF|L|S|C|X|Ku|K|Ka|V|W|mmWave (no strict enum; any non-empty string accepted).

waveform_family.description: Waveform family. Typical values: pulsed|lfm|fmcw|nlfm|pulse_doppler|cw (no strict enum; any non-empty string accepted).

center_frequency_hz.description: Carrier / center frequency in hertz (Hz); must be strictly positive.

sample_rate_hz.description: Complex baseband sampling rate in hertz (Hz) of the sensor frontend; must be strictly positive.
